query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Across the Ashcombe listings, which seller is cheapest for size M, and what is that price? Only count a listing that can actually supply that size.

The results page lists 15 listings on one page; there is no next page.
Listings by advertised price, read from the results page:
1. Quarles Apparel, advertised $18.11, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-10.html
2. Ivybridge Uniforms, advertised $18.37, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-15.html
3. Brindle Uniforms, advertised $18.53, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-04.html
4. Copperfield Outfitters, advertised $18.74, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-11.html
5. Fairhaven Textiles, advertised $20.39, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-01.html
6. Rookwood Outfitters, advertised $21.62, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-03.html
7. Pentland Threads, advertised $24.68, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-14.html
8. Haldane Textiles, advertised $25.92, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-07.html
9. Oakhurst Apparel, advertised $27.66, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-08.html
10. Northwick Apparel, advertised $27.70, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-12.html
11. Kelsall Supply, advertised $29.51, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-05.html
12. Dunmore Collective, advertised $34.55, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-02.html
13. Jarrow Threads, advertised $35.74, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-06.html
14. Garrick Collective, advertised $35.81, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-13.html
15. Alderney Garments, advertised $39.60, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-09.html

Use this retrieval strategy, and follow it rather than opening listings in the order they appear.
1. Read the advertised price of every listing from the search results first. That price is the cheapest option in that listing that can be bought, so nothing in it that can be bought costs less.
2. Open listings in ascending order of advertised price. For each one, do two separate things. First, choose the option asked about, then look at the page again and read the price it now shows. The price a listing shows before you choose is its cheapest option that can be bought, not necessarily the one asked about, and the reply to choosing an option does not show the new price. Second, check whether that option can actually be bought. An option can be listed and still be unavailable, in which case it is shown as disabled or greyed out and cannot be chosen from the menu, so it has no price you can use.
3. A listing only becomes your best candidate if the option is both cheaper and available. A cheaper unavailable one changes nothing.
4. Open every listing on the page before answering.
In your answer, name the seller, give the price, and say explicitly that you checked the option was available rather than only listed. Say how many listings you opened, and how many you rejected for being unavailable.
Important: the advertised price is the price of the cheapest option that can be bought, which need not be the option asked about. It is not a price read for the option asked about, and must never appear in your answer as one. Only report a price you read from a listing you opened, for the exact option asked about, read after that option was chosen. Never pair an advertised price with an option unless you saw that price shown while that option was chosen.

result.final: Cheapest seller for size M is Copperfield Outfitters at $23.43. I explicitly checked availability: in Copperfield Outfitters' size dropdown the M option was enabled/selectable (not disabled or greyed out), and after choosing M the page showed $23.43. I opened all 15 listings on the results page, and rejected 8 for being unable to supply size M (Quarles Apparel, Ivybridge Uniforms, Brindle Uniforms, Fairhaven Textiles, Rookwood Outfitters, Dunmore Collective, Jarrow Threads, Alderney Garments), where M was either disabled in the menu or absent entirely. 7 listings offered size M; their prices with M chosen were: Copperfield Outfitters $23.43, Pentland Threads $26.03, Haldane Textiles $26.21, Oakhurst Apparel $27.66, Northwick Apparel $28.76, Kelsall Supply $29.51, Garrick Collective $35.81. The advertised prices were only used to order the listings and were never paired with size M.
